edits.before: Bravado-weave the trades — the empowered autos refund cooldowns; the loop is the lane.
edits.after: Bard's ranged Q poke and stun threat outrange your dashless kit early at level 1.

edits.before: Q-charges bank heals: the gemstone economy opens.
edits.after: His chime lead and Q zoning keep tempo his at level 2.

edits.before: Full kit: W-link the carry and the E stuns from two bodies — the double angle is the trap.
edits.after: His poke-and-roam pattern keeps pressuring you more than your kit can punish back.

edits.before: - Bard Cosmic Binding: matchup-defining — The wall-stun starts every Bard pick — never hug terrain near him. The duo's tempo bends around it. - Keep R Cosmic Radiance banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Bard Cosmic Binding: 11s at rank 1, down to 7s by rank 5 — the wall-stun starts every Bard pick; never hug terrain near him. - Your R Cosmic Radiance is 180s at rank 1, 120s at rank 3 — bank it for their best play, not a habit.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Cosmic Binding is 11s at rank 1 — dodge it once and Bard has no follow-up stun for the rest of the trade.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Tempered Fate has a long wind-up arc -- the cue gives time to walk your carry out before stasis lands.
